scope: All 34 actual returns inspected on nine immutable alpha comparison pages, with targeted full-raw and exact-native/source-candidate refinements: 30 passed and four confirmed art failures. Two refused originals remain unqualified. Complete SHA bindings control shifted review indices. No speculative glasses repairs: Moscicki variants, Bento, Alfredo and Francisco Leal do not establish reliable spectacle rims/bridge in their exact sources. Walery full raw retains actual short broad lower-chin hair; no unsupported upper-cheek beard ordered. Saturated coloured raw-preview edge RGB is not an independent rejection reason: two native alpha crops were separately tested.
